The pinned deployment snapshot marks this record sourceRef as unresolved, so the feed itself does not name the source commit. The revision recorded here is the one this reproduction proves, and git describe calls it v4.0.0-12-g59d3ecf5, so it is not the v4-core@1.0.0 tag the feed cites.
A source-to-runtime reproduction is not a deployment receipt and not an audit. It proves that the bytes running at this address are the bytes this repository compiles from the pinned revision.
